newsitem.title: UK: BOE allots 185 mln stg in outright bills, repo.
newsitem.headline: BOE allots 185 mln stg in outright bills, repo.

text.p: The Bank of England said that it provided the UK money market with 185 million stg of assistance, bringing total liquidity provided to the market to 2.2 billion.
The Bank revised its forecast for the day's liquidity shortage to 2.2 billion from the initial 2.15 million stg.
In its 1330 GMT operations, it allotted 128 million stg in outright bills and 57 million in 6.5 percent repos to July 11 and 14.
